name: Loyalty
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
body:
Drawbacks
Loyalty
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
Category Faction
You resist attempts to dissuade you from obeying the Decemvirate’s will. You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and spelllike abilities.
